data.long_meaning: Abd is the Arabic word for servant, and Al is the Arabic word for Allah. Thus, Abdaal means a servant of Allah. The name Abdaal carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Abdaal usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Ultimately, striving towards the attainment of this title offers individuals a purposeful focus for their lives and a powerful source of motivation and inspiration for their spiritual journey.
